q1_baseline.primary: 5-fold out-of-fold isotonic regression of error on q1
q1_baseline.sensitivity: 5-fold out-of-fold logistic calibration of error on q1

materiality.invariance_material_if: in at least one GPT cell, max spread >= 0.05 AND at least 3 consecutive frozen-lambda points have spread >= 0.02

requires_all: no-lambda statement is defined as: no observed Task-014 delta policy is loss-minimizing among the five observed deltas on any positive-lambda interval
that statement survives the rationalization audit
rank-preserving shifts induce material positive regret vs the q1-only invariant baseline across a broad lambda interval
claim does not require a ground-truth oracle
wording avoids calling the model irrational
result is nontrivial beyond the Task-014 cost sweep

claim_gate.NORMATIVE_RESCOPED_TO_INVARIANCE: strong no-lambda wording fails or is ambiguous, BUT transformation-invariance is rigorous AND rank-preserving shifts produce material loss spread or pass-through regret under the frozen materiality rule
claim_gate.NO_NEW_NORMATIVE_UPGRADE: spreads small, baseline adds little, or argument restates 012/014
claim_gate.CONTRADICTION_OR_ERROR: inconsistent lambda threshold in existing analysis, unreproducible numbers, or mathematically invalid claims

two_rationalization_questions.Q1_operating_point: Is each observed delta policy best among the five for some lambda?
two_rationalization_questions.Q2_response_curve: Does one fixed lambda make all five observed delta policies simultaneously loss-minimizing?
